sources.758: Use a short title line, then 3-6 bullet points. Each bullet one clear idea. End with "Next:" and one suggested action.
sources.759: Answer in 2-4 short sentences. No filler. Lead with the result, then one next action if useful.

sources.761: Explain as numbered steps (1., 2., 3.). One action per step. Mention risks or prerequisites briefly if relevant.

sources.857:
Languages validated (syntax only; the code is never run):
- Python (.py)
- JavaScript (.js, .mjs, .cjs), JSX (.jsx)
- TypeScript (.ts), TSX / React (.tsx)
- JSON (.json), HTML (.html, .htm), SQL (.sql): built into FastFile
- Java (.java), Go (.go), C# (.cs): with javac / gofmt / csc installed on this PC (otherwise FastFile says which one is missing)
In the chat: ask to validate a path, or "load source to validate" to pick the file. The "</> Code: learn more" button explains everything.
